subject: Request: permission to use quote + Helix logo in Redwood Customer Spotlight
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@helixmedia.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to use quote + Helix logo in Redwood Customer Spotlight

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We pulled together a short "Customer Spotlight" draft that highlights the work Helix Media and Redwood did on streaming-index latency reductions. The attached PDF has the proposed one-paragraph quote we pulled from your feedback and a layout mock that includes the Helix wordmark and a small lockup.

Quick asks: would Helix be comfortable with us doing the following in marketing and on our website?
- Use the short quote (see page 1) attributed to you / Helix Media
- Use the Helix wordmark at the small lockup size shown in the mock
- Publish the two-paragraph case study on our customer stories page and in a short press social post

If helpful, we can send a version with additional context or offer to route the final to legal. No rush — if you can confirm by EOD next Tuesday (Aug 3) that would keep us on the campaign calendar.

Attachments: redwood_spotlight_draft_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference
Making high-performance LLM inference accessible to engineering teams

From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@helixmedia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Tang <sara.tang@helixmedia.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use quote + Helix logo in Redwood Customer Spotlight

Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over. Quick read looks good. A couple of notes from our side:
1) The quote is fine but please attribute to "Liam Porter, Head of Data Engineering, Helix Media" (that exact title).
2) We need a short logo usage agreement included; our legal team prefers a one-page confirmation specifying size and placement and a prohibition on implying endorsement of products.
3) Please do not use any Helix customer names or screenshots of our internal dashboards in the case study. The draft currently looks clean on that front.

I've looped Sara from legal — she'll take a look at the mock and the usage language. Sara, can your team provide the standard logo usage agreement or confirm acceptance of the attached draft?

If we can get legal sign-off by Friday we'll be able to go live next week.

Best,
Liam
Liam Porter
Head of Data Engineering, Helix Media
liam.porter@helixmedia.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: permission to use quote + Helix logo in Redwood Customer Spotlight

Marissa / Grace —

Liam's note looks straightforward. Per process, we should:
1) Send Helix our standard one-page "logo usage confirmation" (I attached the template in the Drive link) and ask legal to countersign if they want edits.
2) Confirm the exact quote wording and attribution (Liam, Head of Data Engineering) — small tweak below that matches their ask.
3) Ensure marketing doesn't include any internal screenshots or customer names beyond Helix.

I've penciled this to be part of the cadence for the campaign next week. If Helix signs the usage agreement by EOD Friday we'll be live Tuesday (Aug 4).

Suggested reply to Liam: thank Sara for reviewing, attach our logo usage agreement and the updated quote text, request Sara's redlines if any, and offer to have legal coordinate a one-line endorsement clause removal if they need it.

I'll be on standby to expedite the deal paperwork if marketing needs a quick DocuSign.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0114

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@helixmedia.com>, Sara Tang <sara.tang@helixmedia.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Helix logo usage agreement + confirmed quote

Hi Liam / Sara —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is our one-page logo usage confirmation that incorporates the size/placement language and an explicit line that Helix does not endorse a particular Redwood product. We also updated the quote attribution to: "Liam Porter, Head of Data Engineering, Helix Media."

If this looks good to you, please reply with a one-line approval and we'll attach the signed PDF to the case study and proceed with the social post. If Sara would prefer to return a countersigned PDF, happy to accept.

Attachments: helix_logo_usage_agreement.pdf

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
